items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy's cousin (or a nephew), his name is Boo Frazier - he'd ring the doorbell and he'd have a basket full of food for me

ctx.x: Where did you get the money to feed and clothe them?

I had royalties coming in and friends helped, especially Dizzy Gillespie and Lorraine. I never asked them for anything in my life, but it seems like they were in tune with me. Days I thought I wouldn't have anything to eat - Dizzy's cousin (or a nephew), his name is Boo Frazier - he'd ring the doorbell and he'd have a basket full of food for me - hams, steaks, and a lot of things in there.
